findings.title: IBM Aspera Faspex Authorization Bypass
findings.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability allows authorized users to gain full administrative privileges.

findings.title: SignalWire FreeSWITCH RCE (CVE-2026-116779)
findings.summary: A vulnerability in the handling of inbound SIP MESSAGE requests allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary FreeSWITCH API commands.

findings.title: GPUStack Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-102895)
findings.summary: An authentication bypass allows remote attackers to gain unauthenticated administrator access by spoofing a loopback source address.

findings.title: OpenSSH 'SSHole' Auth Bypass
findings.summary: A password authentication bypass exists in OpenSSH when used with musl libc without PAM.

findings.title: Google Chrome XML Use-After-Free
findings.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component of Google Chrome allows remote code execution.

findings.title: Barracuda ESG/ADC Root Access Chain
findings.affected_technology: Barracuda Email Security Gateway / Load Balancer ADC
findings.summary: A combination of authentication bypass and command injection allows unauthenticated attackers to gain root access.

findings.title: N-able N-central 'Able2Shell' Account Takeover
findings.summary: Authentication bypass vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated attackers to take over administrative accounts.

findings.title: Microsoft Outlook Spoofing Vulnerability
findings.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook allows attackers to perform unauthorized actions over a network.

findings.title: SAP NetWeaver and Web Dispatcher 'ICM2SHELL/ProxyGate'
findings.affected_technology: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP / SAP Web Dispatcher
findings.summary: Memory corruption vulnerabilities in network input processing allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
